entities.name: Alhammarret's Archive
entities.description: Archive of Alhammarret's notes, theories and ponderings on Vryn, on a raised dais in a large building.

entities.name: Alhammarret
entities.description: High arbiter and mind mage of Vryn who manipulated the warring factions and Jace Beleren; killed by Jace.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker, Alhammarret's apprentice, who killed him and planeswalked away.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: Plane where Alhammarret arbitrated warring factions.

events.summary: Alhammarret secretly manipulates Vryn's factions to keep the conflict going.
events.quote: Alhammarret was a high arbiter and mind mage who arbitrated the warring factions of Vryn while secretly manipulating them to keep the conflict going so that he could retain his position.

events.summary: Jace discovers the truth and kills Alhammarret by making him forget how to breathe, then planeswalks away.
events.quote: Eventually, Jace discovered the truth and ended up killing Alhammarret by making him forget how to breathe, following which he planeswalked away.

relations.quote: He was also the mentor of Jace Beleren and would send him to get intelligence from both sides.
